title: Kinda works...
text:
Kinda works.... Was so hoping this was going to be awesome, but it's not.
First off, if the stick of butter is too hard, it won't slice through.
Secondly, it's nearly impossible to clean.

product_metadata.title: RSVP Endurance Butter Slicer in Stainless Steel
features: Quickly slice perfect pats of butter - ideal for individual servings or for preparing butter for pastry doughs
You won't know how you lived without this time saving invention
description: RSVP strives to offer quality kitchen products and cooking tools at competitive prices. Our Endurance Butter Slicer is a perfect example. Quickly slice perfect pats of butter with our quality 18/8 stainless steel butter slicer. Ideal for individual servings or for preparing butter for pastry doughs. Measures 2-3/4-inches by 1/2-inch by 8-inches. Dishwasher safe. When all the right people, and ingredients, kitchen tools, and food come together, we call this The Art of Gathering.
